security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Upload archives and exFAT volume images to an FTP server without extracting them
bundle.longDescription: StreamExtract streams the contents of RAR, ZIP, 7z and tar archives, and exFAT volume images, to an FTP server without extracting anything to disk.
